text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa! What do you mean 
"scary"?! Golshi-chan is celebrating you 
from the bottom of her heart here!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No, you just giving a normal 
congratulation... is totally impossible...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-chan just... wanted to celebrate... 
Jordan's... *sniff*... Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, could you cut out that subtly 
monotone delivery? The only one who falls 
for that is McQueen-chan...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What, where's your hype? Well, whatever. I 
left your present in your room, so make 
sure to grab it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ain't nothing special to it. It's a whole 
bucket of natto! Oh, don't worry, I made 
sure to stir it up 100 times for ya☆
